name: GalaxyBot
description: GalaxyBot is a Discord Bot with over 2M users centered around support systems, moderation & advanced team management.

name: NoRiskClient
description: NoRiskClient is a custom Minecraft Client with about 8.5k users in our closed beta. It provides an extensive set of features e.g. the possibility to securely host singleplayer worlds publicly via a custom proxy and play minigames like tetris against other players.

name: McReal.
description:
McReal. is a social media app like BeReal. but for Minecraft. It allows you to share your builds and and current activities once per day, check out other players pinned posts and comment under their posts.

McReal. is part of NoRiskClient and therefore still in closed beta.

name: Rustcord
description: A cross-platform Discord Desktop App written from scratch in Rust. Work in Progress

name: OAuth System
description:
A custom OAuth system that supports custom roles, scopes, external Apps, permissions and 2FA for my own personal projects.
This is currently being reworked in rust and react native.

name: SmartHome
description: A custom SmartHome backend and frontend that supports Ikea Tradfri and Shelly devices and syncs device states to every open App in real-time.

name: ProjectHub
description:
A cross-platform project management desktop app with features similar to Jira and Trello. It supports realtime data sync over multiple independent instances without a server.
Archived school project from 12th grade.

name: RCON-Web
description: A WebApp that allows you to manage your Minecraft Server via the RCON protocol. It supports multiple servers and provides basic but useful features like player management and console access.

name: Framework
description:
A custom "Web-Framework" written in Go that makes it easy to write dynamic html templates, map them to stylesheets and scripts and render them either server-side or client-side.
This was just a fun challenge but I still use it in some of my older projects.
